title: Spawn frag
wikitext:
The term '''spawn frag''' is used to explain the situation where one player gets an easy [[frag]] against his opponent who just spawned (and thus has only 100 health points and no weapon but [[Boomstick]] and [[Axe]]). Some [[:Category:Maps|maps]] tend to give a lot of "free" spawn frags, for example [[DM4]]. When a player is getting spawn fragged a lot, it is called "spawn rape".


{{terminology}}
